shortTitle: AASM Adult OSA Evaluation & Long-Term Care Guideline
citation: Epstein LJ, Kristo D, Strollo PJ Jr, et al. Clinical guideline for the evaluation, management and long-term care of obstructive sleep apnea in adults. J Clin Sleep Med. 2009;5(3):263-276.
libraryStatus: Exact 2009 full-text source was supplied and content-verified in the Sleep Pathways Guild project session on 2026-08-07. A separate 2015 AASM adapted visual summary of the guideline was also supplied and verified.

companionResource.title: Evaluation, Management and Long-Term Care of OSA in Adults
companionResource.role: adapted visual teaching summary of the 2009 guideline; not a separate controlling authority

currencyNote: BRPT continues to list this broad adult OSA guideline in its recommended-reading universe. It remains useful for the overall chronic-care framework, but newer AASM documents govern narrower topics where they supersede or update this 2009 guidance.
bestFor: Broad adult OSA evaluation, patient education, chronic-disease management framework, treatment-option awareness, PAP support concepts, alternative-therapy awareness, and long-term follow-up context.

mappingRationale.D1A: Supports broad adult OSA risk, symptom, history, examination, and evaluation concepts.
mappingRationale.D1B: Supports patient-education themes including disease understanding, treatment expectations, risk-factor modification, and drowsy-driving counseling.
mappingRationale.D1C: Supports therapy-support and adherence concepts within chronic OSA management.
mappingRationale.D4A: Provides broad PAP initiation, support, troubleshooting, adherence, and follow-up context, subordinate to newer PAP-specific guidance.
mappingRationale.D4B: Provides broad awareness of behavioral, oral-appliance, surgical, positional, and adjunctive alternatives, subordinate to newer therapy-specific guidance.

authorityBoundary: Do not use this 2009 guideline as the controlling source when newer applicable AASM guidance exists. Use the 2017 adult OSA diagnostic-testing guideline for current diagnostic-testing guidance; the 2019 PAP treatment guideline and applicable PAP titration guidance for PAP treatment; the 2015 oral-appliance guideline for oral-appliance therapy; the 2021 surgical-referral guideline for surgical consultation; the 2021 longitudinal PSG/HSAT guidance statement for follow-up testing; and the current AASM Scoring Manual for scoring rules. Current ICSD classification controls diagnostic terminology where relevant.
copyrightUse: Use bibliographic metadata, public section/figure topics, original summaries, learning objectives, and original redraw concepts only. Do not reproduce the guideline figures, flowcharts, tables, recommendation text, or substantial passages in V3.
